title: R3_AI_FREEZE_RECORD
head: e0f68dea
freeze_meaning: The evidence programme is exhausted, not successful. Every defined AI class has a final disposition and none reached VALIDATED. The finding is that on the substrate available - one to two independent date units per market - no AI component demonstrates incremental decision value over R2, and several cannot be tested at all. That is a real result and it is the reason to stop, not a reason to keep searching for a model that passes.
what_reopens_the_programme: the prequential ledger reaching 50+ scored predictions
a decision cohort spanning 10+ well-populated dates per market
a genuinely new scientific question with predefined criteria
after_freeze: evidence refresh · recalibration · drift detection · model health · monitoring only. No new AI architecture search.
